final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM hall_of_fame h JOIN player p ON p.player_id = h.player_id GROUP BY p.death_state), overall AS (SELECT AVG(player_count) AS avg_count FROM state_counts) SELECT AVG(s.player_count) AS average_count, AVG(s.player_count - o.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM state_counts s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.player_count > o.avg_count
